ruler: The approved Error parity policy measures status, `error`, and each issue's code, path and contract-defined message. Zod's extra issue metadata (`expected`/`received`/`options`/bounds/`inclusive`) is deliberately NOT part of the contract, so the oracle projects real issues onto that ruler before comparing. A difference the ruler does not measure is not a divergence.
